## Summary

What problem or requested outcome does this implement?

## Changes

Important implementation decisions and any dependency/documentation changes.

## Validation

Commands/checks actually run and results. Separate pending checks and explain limitations.

## Visual changes

Layout, responsive behavior, interaction, accessibility, reduced motion, and design critique. Use “None” for nonvisual changes.

## Content verification

List changed personal claims and their approved source IDs/passages. Confirm no unsupported claims or authentic-looking fabricated assets were introduced. Use “No personal content changed” when applicable.

## Screenshots

Attach representative desktop/mobile images for meaningful visual changes when supported; otherwise specify pending capture or “Not applicable.”
